next.settings.conflict: The settings file on the machine has changed. We read it again — make the change once more.
next.settings.notLoaded: The settings are not loaded yet
next.settings.unsupported: This machine does not serve the agents’ settings yet: update its runtime.
next.settings.general.theme.hint: Light, dark or as the system has it. Kept in this browser
next.settings.general.textSize.hint: Messages and the field in a chat
next.settings.general.language.hint: The language is set when the app is installed, and changed there
next.settings.general.editor.hint: Not available yet: a browser cannot open a file on the machine
next.settings.general.idleStop.hint: A chat's terminal with no work closes and frees memory; the next message starts the agent again
next.settings.foot.claude.git: The settings of this machine: others have their own. A project’s rules in .claude/settings.json outweigh these.
next.settings.foot.codex.tools: The settings of this machine: others have their own. A one-off change is the -c flag at launch.
next.settings.opt.claude.fallbackModel.h: The spare model the agent switches to by itself
next.settings.opt.claude.ultracode.hint: Dynamic workflows with subagents on every task, at any depth
next.settings.opt.claude.thinking.hint: Slower, but fewer misses on hard tasks
What the agent does without your approval
next.settings.opt.claude.sandbox.hint: Commands see only the project folder and the sites the rules allow
next.settings.opt.claude.memory.hint: The agent writes down what is worth remembering between sessions
next.settings.opt.claude.hooks.hint: Your own commands before and after the agent’s actions. Turning this off disables them all
next.settings.opt.claude.coauthor.hint: A Co-Authored-By line in every commit the agent makes
next.settings.opt.codex.fast.hint: Answers faster, uses the subscription’s limit faster
next.settings.opt.codex.network.hint: Download packages and call APIs from commands
next.settings.choice.outputStyle.Learnin: Leaves part of the work to you
next.settings.choice.permissionMode.plan: Changes nothing until you approve the plan
next.settings.choice.permissionMode.dont: What the rules do not allow is refused
next.settings.choice.sandboxMode.workspa: Writes only to the working folder
next.settings.rules.title: Rules for commands
next.settings.rules.foot: A ban outweighs a permission. A project’s rules in .claude/settings.json add to these.
next.settings.rules.hint.Bash: A command pattern. * is any continuation
next.settings.rules.hint.Read: A path or a file mask
next.settings.rules.errMcp: Name a server, for example gitlab
next.settings.env.title: Environment variables
next.settings.env.foot: Every session of the agent gets them. Keys and tokens show only their tail.
next.settings.env.name: NAME
next.settings.env.errName: The name is capital letters, digits and _
next.settings.env.errValue: The value is one line of up to 2000 characters
next.settings.env.errBaseUrl: The address of the requests is changed in “Models and keys”
next.settings.accounts.keyNote: Set in the agent’s environment, never sent here
next.settings.accounts.signIn.claude: Sign in in the machine’s terminal: claude auth login
next.settings.accounts.signIn.codex: Sign in in the machine’s terminal: codex login
next.settings.accounts.terminal: Signing in and keys are the agent’s own business: it keeps them on the machine. They are not typed or shown here.
next.settings.accounts.proxyBad: An address like https://llm.example.com is needed
next.settings.accounts.foot: A subscription spends its limits, a key spends money from a balance. Through a proxy the requests are counted and limited on its side.
next.settings.skills.empty.skills.claude: No skills. Put a SKILL.md into ~/.claude/skills/<name>/ — it will show up here.
next.settings.skills.empty.skills.codex: No skills. Put a SKILL.md into ~/.codex/skills/<name>/ — it will show up here.
next.settings.skills.empty.mcp.claude: No MCP servers. Add one with claude mcp add — it will show up here.
next.settings.skills.empty.mcp.codex: No MCP servers. Add one under [mcp_servers] in config.toml — it will show up here.
next.settings.skills.foot.skills.claude: The agent will not call a skill that is off: a Skill(name) ban is added to settings.json. It can be turned back on at any time.
next.settings.skills.foot.skills.codex: Codex’s skills are only listed here: a skill is turned on or off in its config.toml.
next.settings.skills.foot.mcp.claude: The agent does not use a server that is off: an mcp__name ban is added to settings.json. The servers added with claude mcp add are shown.
next.settings.skills.foot.mcp.codex: A server that is off gets enabled = false in config.toml.
next.settings.machines.foot: New chats open on the main machine. The cluster keeps the list: a machine cannot be added from this screen yet.
next.settings.apps.desc.tracker: Your epics and tasks from the tracker: the agent reads them with the token of this machine
next.settings.apps.desc.gitlab: Merge requests of the instance with their pipelines and approvals: the agent reads them with the token of this machine
next.settings.apps.foot: An app is connected on the machine: its address and token live in the machine’s environment. They cannot be set from here, so a card has no “Connect” button: if the app is off, it says what is missing.
next.settings.general.topTabs.hint: Open chats, designs and pages stay as tabs above the window
next.settings.general.paneAuto: Open what the agent works on
next.settings.general.paneAuto.hint: A design, document or board the agent works on opens in the right pane by itself
next.settings.general.feed.design.hint: Designs the agent created or changed
next.settings.general.feed.mr.hint: MRs and PRs the agent opened
next.settings.general.feed.stand.hint: Feature stands and dev servers the agent showed
next.settings.general.feed.file.hint: Every file the agent created or changed
next.settings.lead.beta: Features still being worked on. Off by default
next.settings.beta.foot: Turned on in this browser only.
next.settings.beta.retitle.hint: The chat menu gets “Update title”: a model names the chat again from its content
next.settings.beta.multiModel.hint: A new chat can pick several models: one prompt starts one chat per model
next.settings.general.limitContinue.hint: When the subscription's limit runs out in the middle of work, the chat goes on by itself once the limit resets
next.settings.general.restartContinue.hi: Work that a restart cut short goes on by itself
